answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted reputation ladder: a new agent starts at the ridge with no trust and must earn its way down through small, verifiable jobs before it can touch anything valuable. Each completed job is refracted like light through a prism — peers check the work from different angles, so a fake identity cannot pass by copying one review. Over time the honest keys cluster into an oasis of trusted counterparties, while sybils stay stranded at the ridge because every fresh key restarts with zero history and real work costs time they cannot fake.
